controls: Native XZ continuation contains 0x84; mixed contains raw 0x02 and state reset 0xB0. Explicit reset-composition adapts genuine packed chunks with authored A0/C0 control/header changes and is independently full-byte accepted by 7-Zip and Python liblzma. Adapted headers are not claimed as direct native producer output.
